# Dataset — PlantVillage

This folder does not contain the actual image data.
Images are too large to store on GitHub.
Follow the instructions below to download and set up the dataset locally.

---

## Dataset Information

| Property | Details |
|---|---|
| Name | PlantVillage Dataset |
| Source | Kaggle |
| Total images | ~54,305 |
| Total classes | 38 plant disease categories |
| Image format | JPEG (.jpg) |
| License | Public domain / CC0 (research use) |
| Original paper | Hughes & Salathé, 2015 |

---

## Download Instructions

### Step 1 — Create a Kaggle account
Go to https://www.kaggle.com and sign up for a free account if you do not have one.

### Step 2 — Download the dataset
Go to this link and click Download:
https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/emmarex/plantdisease

You will get a ZIP file of approximately 600 MB.

### Step 3 — Extract the ZIP file
Extract the ZIP file so your folder structure looks exactly like this:

data/
├── README.md                   ← this file
└── PlantVillage/
    ├── Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot/
    ├── Pepper__bell___healthy/
    ├── Potato___Early_blight/
    ├── Potato___Late_blight/
    ├──
